sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "attendance"."link_to_event" AS e, "event"."location" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "attendance" JOIN "event" ON "event"."event_id" = "attendance"."link_to_event"  GROUP BY "attendance"."link_to_event", "event"."location"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m2" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: share of the all total of number of attendance records (all level)
rank within the group by number of attendance records: share of the all total, keep the top 3
